#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    
    int current = m;
    bool possible = true;
    
    if (w >= 4) {
        while (current > 0) {
            int r = current % w;
            if (r > 1 && r != w - 1) {
                possible = false;
                break;
            }
            current = (current + 1) / w;
        }
    }
    
    cout << (possible ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
